name: aislopmeter
description: Measure the AI slop on any website, local app or project folder, then fix it with step-by-step, site-specific instructions.
long_description: AI Slop Meter scores a website, a localhost app or a project folder for AI slop: generic copy, the default AI-builder look and unfinished details. Every finding comes with steps, the exact file:line places and a done-when check. It crawls whole sites, writes a visual report and works in English and Turkish. Runs locally; nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: slop_scan
tools.description: Scan a website, localhost app, project folder or .html file for AI slop

tools.name: slop_rescue_plan
tools.description: Turn a scan into a phased, site-specific plan

tools.name: slop_page
tools.description: The report for one page of a site scan

tools.name: slop_report
tools.description: Write or open the visual report

tools.name: slop_guide
tools.description: Read the criteria and the rescue guides

prompts.name: rescue
prompts.description: Scan, plan, fix and re-measure until the target score
prompts.text: Rescue ${arguments.target} from AI slop with AI Slop Meter.

prompts.name: fix
prompts.description: Fix the single most important problem and show the difference
prompts.text: Fix the next AI slop problem in ${arguments.target}.
